overview: Introduce BulkLinkController (POST /api/v1/links/bulk) and BulkLinkService. The service loops over items, calls LinkService.create for each, and maps outcomes to a sealed BulkItemResult (Created or Rejected with a problem type). Because LinkService.create runs each insert in its own transaction, a failure on one item cannot roll back another. The request is bounded to 1-100 items with bean validation; per-item content is validated by the existing domain rules so error types stay identical to the single-create endpoint.

components.name: BulkLinkController
components.responsibility: HTTP contract, request size validation, DTO mapping

components.name: BulkLinkService
components.responsibility: Independent per-item creation and exception-to-result mapping

apiChanges.description: Create up to 100 links; returns per-item CREATED/REJECTED results and counts

decisions.rationale: Clients get one predictable shape; 207 Multi-Status is a WebDAV code with uneven client support
Single source of truth for validation, alias policy and collision handling
At most 100 small inserts; parallelism adds connection-pool pressure without clear benefit

decisions.decision: Map exceptions to the existing urn:problem types

alternatives.option: One transaction for the whole batch (all-or-nothing)
alternatives.whyNotChosen: The requirement explicitly asks that one bad URL does not fail the batch
Over-engineered for 100 items; adds job storage and status APIs

risks.description: A bulk call consumes one rate-limit token for up to 100 creations, weakening abuse protection
risks.mitigation: Hard cap of 100 items per request; follow-up to weight tokens by item count
Bounded size; each insert is a single indexed write

testStrategy: Unit-test BulkLinkService result mapping with a mocked LinkService (created, invalid URL, invalid alias, alias taken). Integration-test the endpoint with MockMvc: mixed batch, ordering, duplicate alias within a batch, empty and oversized batches, and that created links redirect.
rollbackPlan: Purely additive: revert the commit or stop routing to /api/v1/links/bulk. No schema or data migration to undo; links already created remain valid single links.
